messages.author: 927ac23ad855a96f
messages.subject: App works fine locally, but doesn't function and no error
parts:
My app works great locally, but is unresponsive online (shinyapps.io). Buttons can be clicked, but nothing happens or changes. No errors are returned. The app doesn't grey out either. The only indication that something may be wrong is that I use this function:

            withProgress(message = 'Processing Data', value = 0, {...})


On my local instance it says 'Processing Data' as intended, but online it just says 'message'. I tried removing it, but that doesn't change anything - the app stays unresponsive. 

The only information I have to go on is that perhaps the package order is important, it is the only thing I can gather from the logs. 

The log doesn't indicate that anything is amiss, (appended to end of message); data is being processed. It is almost like the connection between graphs (ggplot) and tables disappears completely online, but is retained locally. My first thought after checking past messages on this board was that it was a memory issue, but I am currently set to 'Large 1GB' on shinyapps.io.  

I've attached a couple data files that are formatted for the app, if they help. Thanks in advance if you have any suggestions or ideas.

messages.author: 315b609c44be60a8
messages.subject: Re: App works fine locally, but doesn't function and no error
parts:
Hi Andy,

Ahhhh, ok, thanks for your time!

The packages used are:

library(ggplot2)

library(pbapply)

library(reshape2)

library(TTR)

library(dplyr)

library(shinyIncubator)

library(shinythemes)

library(data.table)

library(ggtern)

library(shiny)


My first guess was ggplot because there was a recent update which included lots of changes. However, the table view also doesn't work (which doesn't require ggplot - just renderDataTable()). It looks like the error comes up when the application loads on shinyapps.io, so the app is dead on arrival on that page. 

The error is specific to ''spectra' on its own isn't a function or variable in the code - but spectra.line.table, spectra.plot, etc. are. The application takes x-ray spectrum and allows people to find elements (Ca, Pb, Fe, etc.) in their data (analyzing paintings, geologic samples, food, etc.). The functions and objects often have 'spectra' as the prefix of the object name, followed by a period (.). Since the error shows just 'spectra' it makes me wonder if it is systematically mis-reading these functions and variables - but it seems that such an error should be to break it. 

As mentioned before there are no problems running locally - it only becomes an issue on shinyapps.io. 

Thanks again for helping,

---

B. Lee Drake

University of New Mexico

messages.subject: Re: App works fine locally, but doesn't function and no error
parts:
Hi Andy,

You are my hero. The problem was that in creating the table, I used the following code for my ui:

conditionalPanel(
'input.dataset === spectra.line.table',
checkboxGroupInput('show_vars', 'Elemental lines to show:',
names(spectra.line.table), selected = standard)
)


And it should have been better defined, like thus:

conditionalPanel(
condition='input.dataset === spectra.line.table',
checkboxGroupInput('show_vars', 'Elemental lines to show:',
names(spectra.line.table), selected = standard)
)


As to why this error shows up on shinyapps.io and not locally, I don't know, but it is up and working now. Thank you so much for taking the time to look into this issue.

---

B. Lee Drake

Department of Anthropology
University of New Mexico
(505) 510.1518
b.lee...@gmail.com

On Mon, Feb 1, 2016 at 7:51 AM, Andy Kipp <an...@rstudio.com> wrote:
This all looks very fishy to me. In your html doc I see:  data-display-if="input.dataset === spectra.line.table"

Without looking at your code I think this is causing the problem.

On Fri, Jan 29, 2016 at 1:17 PM, Lee Drake <b.lee...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi Andy,

Ahhhh, ok, thanks for your time!

The packages used are:

library(ggplot2)

library(pbapply)

library(reshape2)

library(TTR)

library(dplyr)

library(shinyIncubator)

library(shinythemes)

library(data.table)

library(ggtern)

library(shiny)


My first guess was ggplot because there was a recent update which included lots of changes. However, the table view also doesn't work (which doesn't require ggplot - just renderDataTable()). It looks like the error comes up when the application loads on shinyapps.io, so the app is dead on arrival on that page. 

The error is specific to ''spectra' on its own isn't a function or variable in the code - but spectra.line.table, spectra.plot, etc. are. The application takes x-ray spectrum and allows people to find elements (Ca, Pb, Fe, etc.) in their data (analyzing paintings, geologic samples, food, etc.). The functions and objects often have 'spectra' as the prefix of the object name, followed by a period (.). Since the error shows just 'spectra' it makes me wonder if it is systematically mis-reading these functions and variables - but it seems that such an error should be to break it. 

As mentioned before there are no problems running locally - it only becomes an issue on shinyapps.io. 

Thanks again for helping,

---

B. Lee Drake

Department of Anthropology
University of New Mexico
(505) 510.1518
b.lee...@gmail.com

    

On Fri, Jan 29, 2016 at 12:50 PM, Andy Kipp <an...@rstudio.com> wrote:
Lee,

I am the lead developer on shinyapps.io, so no need reach out to them. ;-)

What packages are you using for plotting? Does 'spectra' mean anything to you? Its possible the error is coming from one of the packages you are using.

-Andy

On Fri, Jan 29, 2016 at 12:23 PM, Lee Drake <thal...@gmail.com> wrote:
Many thanks Andy, I am looking there as well - it must be something with the javascript. Unfortunately, this app uses no custom javascript, so perhaps solving this is beyond my control. I will contact the folks at shinyapps.io and will report back if there is anything that can be changed in the R-code to avoid this. 

On Fri, Jan 29, 2016 at 11:00 AM, Andy Kipp <an...@rstudio.com> wrote:
I checked the Javascript console for your app and I saw errors related to 'spectra'? Are you missing some type of javascript dependency?

Screenshot attached.


​-Andy

On Thu, Jan 28, 2016 at 4:45 PM, Lee Drake <thal...@gmail.com> wrote:
My app works great locally, but is unresponsive online (shinyapps.io). Buttons can be clicked, but nothing happens or changes. No errors are returned. The app doesn't grey out either. The only indication that something may be wrong is that I use this function:

            withProgress(message = 'Processing Data', value = 0, {...})


On my local instance it says 'Processing Data' as intended, but online it just says 'message'. I tried removing it, but that doesn't change anything - the app stays unresponsive. 

The only information I have to go on is that perhaps the package order is important, it is the only thing I can gather from the logs. 

The log doesn't indicate that anything is amiss, (appended to end of message); data is being processed. It is almost like the connection between graphs (ggplot) and tables disappears completely online, but is retained locally. My first thought after checking past messages on this board was that it was a memory issue, but I am currently set to 'Large 1GB' on shinyapps.io.  

I've attached a couple data files that are formatted for the app, if they help. Thanks in advance if you have any suggestions or ideas.
